name: Sasaki Ryuunosuke
source: Ryuunosuke, more frequently addressed by his nickname Ryuu, is a member of the Shuei-Gumi Clan. He is quite overprotective of Shuei-Gumi's boss's son, [url=/c23699]Raku[/url], and is also quite violent against the clan's enemy and whoever insults his dear young master.
